name: India Nippon Electricals Limited
summary: India Nippon Electricals Limited manufactures and sells electronic ignition systems for the automotive industry in India and internationally. The company offers AC Generator/ Flywheel Magneto, Regulator and Rectifier, Integral Unit, and Ignition Coil; Controllers, such as Integrated Starter Generator and controller, electronic fuel injection, and electronic control units. It also provides position, angle, pressure, temperature, oil-level, and speed sensors. In addition, the company offers DC-DC converters, tyre pressure monitoring system, traction motors, and motor controllers.
